title: Create a Personalized Sales Outreach Email
description: Create a concise, personalized sales outreach email based on a prospect's role, company, situation, and likely business needs.
useCase: Use this prompt when you need to turn basic prospect information into a relevant first-touch sales email without relying on generic copy.

variables.name: prospectName
variables.description: The name of the person receiving the email.

variables.name: prospectRole
variables.description: The prospect's job title or role.

variables.name: companyContext
variables.description: Relevant information about the company that can be safely used for personalization.
variables.example: The company recently expanded into three new markets.

variables.name: potentialNeed
variables.description: The problem, challenge, or opportunity you believe may be relevant to the prospect.
variables.example: Maintaining consistent lead follow-up across multiple markets.

variables.name: myOffer
variables.description: The product or service being offered.

variables.name: keyBenefit
variables.description: The most relevant benefit the prospect could receive.
variables.example: More consistent follow-up without adding manual workload.

variables.name: callToAction
variables.description: The desired next step for the prospect.

tips: Give the model real prospect context instead of generic descriptions.
Use only information you can verify about the prospect or company.
Keep the outreach focused on one problem and one relevant benefit.
Test different openings and calls to action rather than sending the same message to everyone.
